 Veterans Day Holiday Closures and Service Information for Wednesday November 11
 November 09, 2026 
 • 
10 days ago 
 In observance of the Veteran s Day holiday on Wednesday, November 11, City of Cambridge offices, libraries, and senior centers will be closed. 
 Payments will not be required at City of Cambridge parking meters and parking meter pay stations. The offices at Cambridge Cemetery, 76 Coolidge Avenue, will be closed on the holiday, though the gates will be open from 7 a.m. - 5 p.m. 
 Curbside collection of trash, recycling, food and yard waste is expected to be suspended on Wednesday, November 11 and will be one day behind schedule that week . 
 Street cleaning that would normally be swept on the second Tuesday of the month occurred in advance. Trash and recycling schedules and routes can be found at Cambrid g eMA.gov/ curbsidecollections . Street cleaning schedules and routes are available at Cambridge M A.gov/ streetcleaning . 
 Residents can receive reminders about curbside collection and other City services by text message, email, or through the Zero Waste Cambridge app for iPhone and Android. 
 Residents can also sign up for street cleaning reminders, City notifications, emergency alerts, and newsletters, including the Daily Update, at CambridgeMA.gov/Subscribe .
